column1: # The blocker ranking: constructs nothing in this engine answers, over a
# public corpus, ranked by the documents they hold back. A report, never a
# gate. sole: documents this construct alone blocks. share: thousandths of
# a document summed over the documents it blocks, splitting each document
# between its blockers. docs: documents it appears in. kind: the subject
# namespace (ctrl | env | aggregate). owner: what defines it (primitive |

# kernel | class: | pkg:

, or an aggregate row for the rest).
# A construct is named only when something public defines it; a name the
# document itself chose, or one the definer scan could not attribute, is
# folded into an aggregate row carrying counts and no name. No corpus
# document is committed and this table carries no document text.
# "Blocked" means "has at least one unknown construct", which is narrower
# than the parity ladder's T0: a document that elaborates with errors and
# no unknown name is unblocked here and still fails T0.
# corpus: 50 lualatex-buildable document(s), 14 with at least one blocker
# errored but unblocked: 33 document(s) — the T0 gap this table does not rank
